parts.text: You're one decision away from a completely different life.
Not a big one. Not quitting your job. Not moving to another country.
It's the small decision you make every morning.
Snooze, or stand up. Scroll, or start. Later, or now.
Most people make the wrong one, every single day, and wonder why nothing changes.
Small choices don't feel important. That's exactly what makes them dangerous.
Because your life is just the sum of your mornings.
Tomorrow, you'll face that choice again.
But make the right one once.
After a week, it's a habit. After a year, it's a different life.
